_: Eldritch End, from Prominence's census (W4 R7, judged 2026-11-12). Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because any word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Spire stone's slabs and stairs were not judged and are left to the rules; the Hasturian sands already wear as sand by detection.

End: Hasturian moss is the living surface of the End's own ground, as Better End's mosses are, and the rules leave it out for having no stone word; spire stone is natural rock found only as the End's ground, and detection gave it stone by the stone in its name.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.20.1 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
